prompt_inputs.goal: Marathon training with high carbohydrate intake and proper meal timing around a 2-hour morning run

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers all three meals plus pre/post-workout nutrition
Carbohydrate intake is elevated and strategically timed around the 2-hour morning training session
Plan is presented in compact, easy-to-read format suitable for a single day
Macronutrient balance supports endurance athletic performance
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a high-intensity endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring high carbohydrate intake and timing around training sessions

prompt_inputs.goal: Muscle recovery and strength gains with 5-6 meals per day

solution_criteria: Meal plan contains 5-6 meals distributed throughout the day
Total daily protein intake meets or exceeds 1.6g per kg of body weight (131g minimum)
All meals comply with stated dietary restrictions
Plan is compact and presented in a clear, easy-to-follow format
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a strength/power athlete (weightlifter) with specific protein requirements and meal frequency preferences for muscle recovery

prompt_inputs.goal: Maintain 68 kg weight class for boxing competition in 3 days while preserving strength and endurance

solution_criteria: Meal plan totals approximately 2,200-2,400 calories to maintain current weight without excess
All meals align with stated dietary restrictions (dairy-free, whole foods only)
Plan is compact and covers all three meals for one day
Meals support athletic performance with adequate protein and carbohydrates for boxing training
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a weight-class constrained athlete (boxer/wrestler) needing a calorie-controlled plan that maintains performance while meeting strict weight limits
